## ISessionLockOnContended type

Contention policy when the session lease cannot be acquired.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ISessionLockOnContended = `skip` | `wait` | `serialize`;
```

## Remarks

- `skip` — drop the contended update (`withLock` resolves `null`<!-- -->). - `wait` — retry every `10ms` until `leaseMs` elapses, then give up with `null`<!-- -->. - `serialize` — queue per session key so contended updates run in order.
